title: Automatic Termination of Insurance and the Agency Program Terms on Home Mortgage Loans
content:
Some insurance on a Home Mortgage Loans note ends without any request from the borrower.

**Automatic termination of private mortgage insurance.** Private mortgage insurance terminates automatically, without a request, on the date the scheduled balance reaches the program's automatic termination figure of original value, provided the loan is current on that date. Where the loan is not current on that date, it terminates instead on the first day of the month after the loan becomes current.

**The FHA program's annual insurance.** Annual insurance on the FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage ends after the number of years that program states, and does so only where the original loan-to-value was 90 percent or less. Where the original loan-to-value was above 90 percent, it lasts for the life of the loan.

**The VA program.** A VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage carries no monthly insurance.

## Condition and result

| Situation | When the insurance ends |
|---|---|
| The scheduled balance reaches the program's automatic termination figure and the loan is current | On that date |
| The scheduled balance reaches that figure and the loan is not current | On the first day of the month after the loan becomes current |
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, original loan-to-value 90 percent or less | After the number of years that program states |
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, original loan-to-value above 90 percent | It lasts for the life of the loan |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | There is no monthly insurance to end |

## Worked reading on hypothetical inputs

A loan reaches its program's automatic termination figure of original value on 12 June and stands delinquent on that date; it becomes current on 3 August. Insurance terminates on 1 September, the first day of the month after the loan became current. Had the loan been current on 12 June, insurance would have terminated on 12 June.
